newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Command says plans to issue statement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Command says plans to issue statement.

text.p: Command Petroleum Holdings NL said it expected to make an announcement at 5.00 p.m. (0700 GMT) on Wednesday.
"We hope to be able to make an announcement at five o'clock today," Command company secretary Bun Hung told Reuters.
Hung said the announcement was subject to a "couple of things happening" before 5.00 p.m.
The company's shares are voluntarily suspended while it conducts merger negotiations.

Command Petroleum is the operator of India's Ravva offshore oilfield and has a 22.5 percent stake in the field. It said last month it had upgraded Ravva's reserves by 22 percent to 189.3 million barrels of oil equivalent, of which 89 percent is oil.
Snyder Oil Corp owns 32.64 percent of Command.
A source close to the negotiations told Reuters last week that Snyder was an unlikely merger candidate.
Command shares last traded on September 24 at 97 cents each, giving the company a market capitalisation of A$312.60 million based on its 322.26 million shares outstanding.
